hindi: शाम की सादी रोटी — बिना पकाया हल्का रात्रिभोज
definition: the cold evening meal of bread, cheese and sausage that gathers a household without any cooking
example: The children were called indoors for Abendbrot before the light had gone.

hindi: शरद की गुनगुनी ऋतु — पतझड़ के आरंभ में लौटी धूप
definition: the warm spell in early autumn when gossamer spider threads drift across fields in the sunlight
example: They ate outdoors all through the Altweibersommer, well into October.

hindi: प्रारंभिक उपागम — समस्या को सुलझाने योग्य बनाने वाली शुरुआती धारणा
definition: a starting assumption chosen deliberately so that a difficult problem becomes tractable enough to attack
example: Her Ansatz was crude, but it turned an intractable integral into arithmetic.

hindi: शिष्टाचार — दूसरों के प्रति बनता व्यवहार
definition: proper conduct owed to others as a matter of course, upheld whether or not anyone is watching
example: He returned the wallet untouched; his grandmother would have called that simple Anstand.

hindi: काम का जुनून — आराम को निगल जाने वाली कार्य-लिप्सा
definition: a driven, almost feverish appetite for work that overruns rest and everything competing with it
example: His Arbeitswut carried the project and cost him every weekend of the spring.

hindi: उन्नयन-निषेध — रद्द करते हुए सुरक्षित रख ऊपर उठाना
definition: the dialectical move that cancels a position and preserves it at once, lifting both into something higher
example: The compromise was less a truce than an Aufhebung: both demands survived, transformed.

hindi: थप्पड़-तलब चेहरा — देखते ही चाँटा मारने का मन करे
definition: a face that somehow invites a slap, provoking irritation before its owner has said anything
example: The landlord smiled, and it was a perfect Backpfeifengesicht.

hindi: पेशेवर स्वाभिमान — घटिया काम न सौंपने देने वाला गर्व
definition: the private pride of a trade, which forbids handing over shoddy work you would be ashamed to sign
example: The carpenter redid the drawer for free; it was a matter of Berufsehre.

hindi: विनम्रता — उपलब्धि होते हुए भी बिना दिखावे के
definition: modesty held as a quiet standard: real achievement carried without announcement or visible pride
example: The Bescheidenheit of the old surgeon meant nobody in the room knew who had trained them.

hindi: धीरज भरी सूझबूझ — दबाव में भी ठंडा दिमाग
definition: level-headed judgement under pressure, the calm of someone who thinks before the room reacts
example: The captain's Besonnenheit during the storm was worth more than any drill.

hindi: आदत का अंधापन — एक ही जगह लंबे काम से खामियाँ न दिखना
definition: the blindness to obvious flaws that comes from working inside the same operation for far too long
example: It took a new hire to point out the broken form; the rest of us had Betriebsblindheit.

hindi: संस्कारयुक्त शिक्षा — केवल पढ़ाई नहीं, समूचा व्यक्तित्व-निर्माण
definition: formation of the whole person through learning and culture, far broader than schooling or training
example: A degree is not Bildung, as he discovered the first time the conversation left his field.

hindi: पुल-दिवस — छुट्टी और सप्ताहांत के बीच पड़ने वाला अकेला कार्यदिवस
definition: a single working day bridging a public holiday and the weekend, taken off by very nearly everyone
example: The office was empty on Friday because the whole team booked the Brückentag.

hindi: सत्-अस्तित्व — भीतर से जिया जाने वाला मानव होना
definition: human existence regarded as something that must be lived, questioned and answered from the inside
example: Heidegger asks what it means to be, and answers only from within Dasein.

hindi: सरकारी रास्ता — निर्धारित आधिकारिक क्रम से गुज़रती अर्ज़ी
definition: the prescribed chain of official channels a request must climb before anyone is allowed to act
example: You can email the director, but the Dienstweg runs through your section head first.

hindi: हमशक्ल — किसी जीवित व्यक्ति का रहस्यमय प्रतिरूप
definition: a living person's uncanny double, whether an eerie apparition or merely a stranger wearing your face
example: A waiter in Lisbon was such a Doppelgänger of my brother that I nearly hugged him.

hindi: मनाने का तोहफ़ा — नाराज़ी भाँपकर पहले से लाया गया उपहार
definition: a peace offering carried home in advance by someone expecting thoroughly deserved domestic anger
example: He bought tulips on the way back, pure Drachenfutter for a missed anniversary.

hindi: तुम कहकर बुलाना — अनौपचारिक संबोधन अपनाना
definition: to address another person with the informal you, the smallest grammatical step into friendship
example: After the second beer the professor finally invited us to duzen him.

hindi: स्वेच्छाचार — अपनी ही राह पर अड़े रहने का स्वभाव
definition: a self-willed streak that insists on its own way, closer to independence than to plain obstinacy
example: Her Eigensinn made her impossible to manage and impossible to replace.

hindi: हिम-संत दिवस — मई के मध्य की अंतिम पाला-रातें
definition: the mid-May saints' days when German gardeners expect one last frost before planting anything out
example: She keeps the tomatoes indoors until the Eisheilige are safely past.

hindi: बोध — सूचना से आगे बढ़कर भीतर उतरी समझ
definition: knowledge arrived at by insight, the moment when information stops being data and becomes understanding
example: After a decade of practice came the quiet Erkenntnis that technique was never the obstacle.

hindi: सफ़ाई का संकट — जवाब देना ज़रूरी, पर देने को कुछ नहीं
definition: the cornered position of owing an explanation you cannot honestly give, where silence looks guilty
example: The minister was in Erklärungsnot the moment the receipts surfaced.

hindi: नकली विकल्प — असली की जगह रखा घटिया बदल
definition: a substitute standing in for the real thing and worse for it, as wartime acorn coffee was for coffee
example: The apology was Ersatz, assembled from phrases a lawyer had approved.

hindi: विषय-अंधा विशेषज्ञ — अपने विषय में गहरा, बाकी सब में कोरा
definition: a specialist so deeply buried in one subject that ordinary judgement outside it has quietly withered
example: Brilliant on tax law and a complete Fachidiot on everything else.

hindi: गलती-संस्कृति — संस्था गलतियों से कैसे पेश आती है
definition: the way an organisation handles mistakes: whether they are buried, punished, or openly examined
example: A team with a real Fehlerkultur writes the postmortem instead of hunting the culprit.

hindi: काम की छुट्टी — दिन का काम खत्म, अब शाम अपनी
definition: the moment work ends and the evening becomes yours, marked as an event rather than a mere clock time
example: He shut the laptop at six and announced Feierabend to nobody in particular.

hindi: दूर-देश की कसक — अनजानी जगहों को देखने की बेचैनी
definition: the ache to be somewhere far away, an inverted homesickness pulling you toward unfamiliar places
example: Every departure board gives her a fresh attack of Fernweh.

hindi: उँगलियों की समझ — नाज़ुक मामले सधे हाथ से सँभालने की सूझ
definition: an intuitive delicacy of touch that lets someone handle people or awkward situations without bruising
example: Negotiations like this need Fingerspitzengefühl, not a louder voice.

hindi: पराई शर्म — दूसरे की हरकत पर खुद शर्मिंदा होना
definition: to burn with embarrassment on behalf of another person who is feeling none of it themselves
example: The best man's speech made everyone at the table fremdschämen quietly.

hindi: दोस्ती का फ़र्ज़ — बिना मोल-भाव किया गया उपकार
definition: a favour done purely out of friendship, unbilled, and quietly expected to be returned someday
example: Carrying his piano up four floors was a Freundschaftsdienst he still brings up.

hindi: वसंत-आलस्य — बसंत आने पर छाने वाली सुस्ती
definition: the sluggish tiredness arriving with spring, when lengthening daylight leaves the body unconvinced
example: Nothing got finished in March, which he blamed entirely on Frühjahrsmüdigkeit.

hindi: मेहमाननवाज़ी — अतिथि-सत्कार का कर्तव्य
definition: hospitality understood as duty, where the guest is fed, warmed, and never permitted to help
example: Their Gastfreundschaft meant three helpings before anyone asked why we had come.

hindi: सुरक्षा-भाव — अपनेपन की ऊष्मा और निश्चिंतता
definition: the warm security of being sheltered, protected and wholly belonging somewhere without fear
example: A child asleep across two laps is the picture of Geborgenheit.

hindi: विचार-प्रयोग — केवल कल्पना में चलाया गया परीक्षण
definition: an imagined scenario run purely in the mind to test whether a theory survives its own logic
example: Einstein chased a beam of light in a Gedankenexperiment long before anyone measured one.

hindi: सुकून भरा अपनापन — गर्मजोशी और इत्मीनान का माहौल
definition: unhurried warmth of a place and company where nobody is anxious and nothing needs finishing
example: Low lamps, a slow conversation, and complete Gemütlichkeit until midnight.

hindi: समग्राकृति — अंगों में न मिलने वाला संपूर्ण रूप
definition: an organized whole whose character cannot be recovered by examining its separated parts one by one
example: The melody is a Gestalt; play the notes in isolation and it disappears.

hindi: सीमा-स्थिति — मृत्यु या अपराधबोध जैसा निर्णायक क्षण
definition: a limit experience such as death, guilt or suffering that strips away routine and forces real choice
example: Illness turned an ordinary Tuesday into a Grenzsituation he could not delegate.

hindi: पूर्णता से काम करना — जड़ तक जाकर, अधूरा कुछ नहीं
definition: thoroughness pursued as a virtue: the job done completely, checked twice, and never merely adequate
example: His Gründlichkeit turned a two-hour repair into a weekend, and the machine has not failed since.

hindi: विचारों का इतिहास — धारणाओं की सदियों भर की यात्रा
definition: the study of how thoughts themselves travel, mutate and acquire authority across the centuries
example: Read enough Ideengeschichte and today's certainties start looking seasonal.

hindi: गप्पों वाली कॉफ़ी-बैठक — मीठे के साथ बतकही
definition: an afternoon gathering over coffee and cake where the actual business being conducted is gossip
example: Her Sunday Kaffeeklatsch ran three hours and settled every rumour on the street.

hindi: निर्मल नीला मौसम — बिलकुल साफ़, धूप-भरा दिन
definition: flawless blue-sky weather, cloudless and bright, of the kind that seems ordered for an occasion
example: The wedding party woke to perfect Kaiserwetter and cancelled the tent.

hindi: खुमारी का मलाल — रात के बाद की सुबह वाली उदासी
definition: the hollow morning-after gloom in which physical wreckage and moral regret arrive together
example: The party was triumphant; the Katzenjammer that followed was not.

hindi: भड़कीली सस्ती कला — दिखावटी और उथली सजावट
definition: art of cheap sentiment, pleasing enough to sell everywhere yet too gaudy for anyone to admit owning
example: Her flat was a shrine to Kitsch: velvet stags, singing clocks, a lamp shaped like a swan.

hindi: दिमाग़ी सिनेमा — कल्पना में चलती अनचाही फ़िल्म
definition: the vivid private film imagination screens for you, replaying scenes you would rather not watch
example: Waiting for the biopsy results, her Kopfkino ran all night.

hindi: ग़म का मोटापा — दुख में खा-खाकर चढ़ा हुआ वज़न
definition: the quiet weight gained from eating your way through heartbreak, grief, or a long bad season
example: Three months after the divorce he blamed the tight jeans on Kummerspeck.

hindi: कम-काम व्यवस्था — मंदी में नौकरी बचाने को घटे हुए घंटे
definition: shortened hours agreed with state support, so a downturn costs workers time rather than their jobs
example: The plant went on Kurzarbeit for six months and kept every worker on the books.

hindi: मूल स्वरलहरी — बार-बार लौटने वाला संगीत-सूत्र
definition: a recurring musical phrase tied to one character or idea, returning whenever the story summons it
example: Four descending notes serve as the villain's Leitmotiv throughout the opera.

hindi: वन-प्रांगण — जंगल के बीच खुली, धूप वाली जगह
definition: an open clearing in woodland where the canopy breaks and daylight reaches all the way to the forest floor
example: The deer were standing in the Lichtung when the path finally opened out.

hindi: हवाई किला — हवा में बना, नींव से ख़ाली मंसूबा
definition: an elaborate plan resting entirely on wishing, with nothing underneath it bearing any weight
example: The whole business plan was a Luftschloss with a beautiful logo.

hindi: नितांत अकेला — दूर-दूर तक कोई नहीं
definition: alone to a desolate degree, without another living human soul anywhere within reach or hearing
example: The station closed at ten and left her mutterseelenallein on the platform.

hindi: पड़ोसी सहयोग — मोहल्ले की बिन-माँगी आपसी मदद
definition: neighbourly help offered as routine, from watering plants to clearing snow off the shared path
example: The snow was gone by Nachbarschaftshilfe long before the council trucks arrived.

hindi: कुहरे का सागर — ऊपर से दिखती घाटी भरती धुंध
definition: an unbroken layer of low fog seen from above, filling a valley so it resembles a white ocean
example: From the summit hut they looked down on a Nebelmeer with only two peaks breaking through.

hindi: दिमाग़ में चिपका गाना — बार-बार अपने आप बजने वाली धुन
definition: a catchy scrap of music that lodges itself in memory and replays on repeat against your wishes
example: That advert jingle became an Ohrwurm she could not shake for days.

hindi: व्यवस्था — हर चीज़ अपनी सही जगह पर, एक नैतिक आदर्श
definition: the settled, correct arrangement of things, treated less as simple tidiness than as a moral condition
example: His desk was a monument to Ordnung, every cable coiled the same way.

hindi: कागज़ी जंग — फ़ाइलों और फ़ॉर्मों की न खत्म होने वाली लड़ाई
definition: a grinding campaign of forms, stamps and correspondence waged against you by an administration
example: Registering the car turned into a three-month Papierkrieg.

hindi: उत्पाती प्रेत — शोर और तोड़फोड़ करने वाली आत्मा
definition: a noisy household spirit blamed for slamming doors, thrown crockery, and furniture that moves itself
example: The family insisted a Poltergeist emptied the cupboards; the plumber blamed the pipes.

hindi: बारह पवित्र रातें — क्रिसमस से एपिफ़नी तक की, प्रेत-वास मानी जाने वाली रातें
definition: one of the twelve nights between Christmas and Epiphany, held in folklore to be haunted by spirits
example: On the first Rauhnacht the farmer walked his stables with incense, as his grandfather had.

hindi: यथार्थ-राजनीति — सिद्धांत नहीं, शक्ति और परिस्थिति से चलती नीति
definition: politics conducted from power and circumstance rather than from principle, ideology or moral preference
example: The treaty was pure Realpolitik, signed by two governments that despised each other.

hindi: परपीड़ा-सुख — दूसरे के दुर्भाग्य पर छिपी खुशी
definition: the quiet and faintly shameful enjoyment a person feels when misfortune lands on somebody else
example: There was open Schadenfreude in the office when the loudest forecast collapsed.

hindi: नशे की सूझ — रात को शानदार, सुबह बेवक़ूफ़ी लगने वाला विचार
definition: a scheme that sounded magnificent late at night over drinks and looks embarrassing by breakfast
example: Driving to the coast at two in the morning was a Schnapsidee.

hindi: बर्फ़ का बगूला — घुमड़ती हुई हिम-बौछार
definition: a brief, swirling flurry of snow driven about by gusts rather than falling steadily to the ground
example: A sudden Schneegestöber swallowed the road markings for a quarter of an hour.

hindi: तड़प — किसी अनाम चीज़ की गहरी लालसा
definition: an aching, unfocused longing for something the heart cannot name and life never quite delivers
example: A Sehnsucht he could not explain kept pulling him back to the harbour at dusk.

hindi: आप कहकर बुलाना — औपचारिक आदरसूचक संबोधन रखना
definition: to address someone with the formal you, holding a polite distance until somebody offers to drop it
example: Colleagues who siezen each other for decades rarely learn the other's first name.

hindi: टिके रहने का दम — कुर्सी छोड़े बिना काम पूरा करने का धीरज
definition: the stubborn endurance to stay seated at tedious work until the difficult thing is actually finished
example: Writing a dissertation takes less brilliance than Sitzfleisch.

hindi: अयनांत — सूर्य के मुड़ने का दिन, संक्रांति
definition: the turning point of the year when the sun reaches its farthest stand and the days change direction
example: The village lights a bonfire every summer Sonnenwende on the hill above the church.

hindi: संकीर्ण दक़ियानूस — नियम-क़ायदों में सिमटा साधारण आदमी
definition: a narrow conventional soul who prizes tidy hedges and correct paperwork above anything unfamiliar
example: He called his neighbour a Spießer for reporting the barbecue to the building manager.

hindi: भाषा की सहज पकड़ — नियम जाने बिना सही-ग़लत का एहसास
definition: an internalised feeling for what sounds right in a language, running deeper than any rule taught
example: No grammar book gave her that Sprachgefühl; eight years in Vienna did.

hindi: पक्का अड्डा — पब की वह मेज़ जहाँ नियमित लोग रोज़ जुटते हैं
definition: the reserved pub table where the same regulars gather each week to settle politics over their beer
example: Every Thursday he vanishes to the Stammtisch and returns with the village's opinions.

hindi: नंबरों का दीवाना — शिक्षक की वाहवाही के लिए खटने वाला
definition: an anxious overachiever who works for the teacher's approval rather than for the subject itself
example: Nobody sat with the class Streber, and he finished top of the year anyway.

hindi: अड़ियलपन — टस से मस न होना
definition: immovable stubbornness, the refusal to bend that is admired in a builder and cursed in a colleague
example: Only his Sturheit kept the project alive after everyone else had quietly written it off.

hindi: समयसीमा का दबाव — तारीख सिर पर होने का बोझ
definition: the squeezing pressure of a deadline bearing down on work that still needs proper attention
example: Under Termindruck she shipped the feature and quietly skipped the tests.

hindi: समय बीतने का भय — मौके बंद होते जाने की घबराहट
definition: the mounting dread that life's important doors are closing while you stand there still deciding
example: Her thirty-ninth birthday brought a wave of Torschlusspanik about the house she never bought.

hindi: सीढ़ी की सूझ — बहस ख़त्म होने के बाद सूझा करारा जवाब
definition: the perfect retort that arrives only on the staircase, long after the argument has been lost
example: His best line was a Treppenwitz, delivered to the elevator doors.

hindi: अतिमानव — अपने मूल्य स्वयं रचने वाला मनुष्य
definition: the self-creating individual of Nietzsche's imagining, who invents values rather than inheriting them
example: Every gym poster quoting the Übermensch has misread the passage it is quoting.

hindi: तय मुलाक़ात — पहले से बँधा हुआ मिलने का वादा
definition: an arranged meeting, binding enough that cancelling it late counts as a small personal betrayal
example: We have a Verabredung at seven, and here that genuinely means seven.

hindi: खोने का डर — प्रिय के छिन जाने की सतत आशंका
definition: persistent fear of losing someone, which quietly damages the closeness it so desperately guards
example: Her Verlustangst turned every unanswered message into an emergency.

hindi: सुधारते-सुधारते बिगाड़ना — भले इरादे से बात और खराब कर देना
definition: to make something worse precisely by trying to improve it, usually with the very best intentions
example: Every attempt to tidy the config only managed to verschlimmbessern the build.

hindi: सुधार के नाम पर बिगाड़ — ठीक करने की कोशिश में और ख़राब
definition: an improvement that leaves the thing worse than it was, combining repair and damage in one act
example: The redesigned checkout page was a textbook Verschlimmbesserung.

hindi: जान-पहचान का ज़ोर — काम निकलवाने वाला रिश्ता
definition: connections as nourishment: the useful acquaintance who opens a door no application ever could
example: He found that apartment through Vitamin B, never through the listing.

hindi: पूर्वानंद — आने वाली खुशी की प्रतीक्षा का सुख
definition: the pleasure of anticipating something good, frequently sweeter than the awaited occasion itself
example: Half the holiday is the Vorfreude of packing the night before.

hindi: वन-एकांत — जंगल में अकेले होने की अनुभूति
definition: the particular solitude of standing alone among trees, half peaceful and half faintly unsettling
example: An hour into the spruce forest the Waldeinsamkeit became almost audible.

hindi: वन-क्षय — अम्ल वर्षा से जंगलों का सूखना
definition: the widespread dieback of trees, blamed on acid rain, that alarmed Germany in the nineteen-eighties
example: Photographs of grey, needleless firs made Waldsterben a household word overnight.

hindi: भ्रमण-लालसा — घुमक्कड़ी की बेचैन इच्छा
definition: a restless craving to travel, less about arriving anywhere particular than about the leaving itself
example: Two weeks back at his desk and the Wanderlust returned like a fever.

hindi: मीठी उदासी — बीती सुंदरता की कोमल टीस
definition: gentle sorrow tinted with sweetness, the mood left behind by something lovely and finished
example: She packed the last box with more Wehmut than regret.

hindi: विश्वदृष्टि — जगत को समझने का समूचा वैचारिक ढाँचा
definition: the whole framework of beliefs through which a person or a culture interprets existence and history
example: Two economists shared one dataset and still disagreed, each reading it through a different Weltanschauung.

hindi: जगत-वेदना — दुनिया की अपूर्णता से उपजा विषाद
definition: world-weary sadness at the distance between how existence is and how it decently ought to be
example: He read the morning headlines and sank into a familiar Weltschmerz.

hindi: मूल्य-निरपेक्षता — शोध में अपनी मान्यताएँ न घुसाने का आदर्श
definition: the ideal that scholarship should describe the world without smuggling the scholar's own values into it
example: Weber demanded Wertfreiheit in the lecture hall and passionate conviction outside it.

hindi: बिन गरज बिजली — क्षितिज पर दूर कौंधती चमक
definition: distant lightning that flickers along the horizon with no thunder audible from where you stand
example: We sat on the balcony watching the Wetterleuchten over the hills, waiting for rain that never came.

hindi: विलक्षण बालक — असमय प्रतिभा दिखाने वाला किशोर
definition: a young person whose talent arrives decades early, in music, chess, mathematics, or business
example: At nineteen she was the firm's Wunderkind; at thirty, simply very good at her job.

hindi: युगधर्म — किसी काल की साझा मनोदशा और मान्यताएँ
definition: the shared mood and unexamined assumptions of a period, visible only once that period has ended
example: Nothing dates a film faster than its confidence about the Zeitgeist.

hindi: अंतर्द्वंद्व — भीतर से दो हिस्सों में बँटे होने की दशा
definition: the torn inner condition of being pulled between loyalties or selves that refuse to reconcile
example: His Zerrissenheit between the family firm and the conservatory lasted a decade.

hindi: नागरिक साहस — अन्याय के विरुद्ध खुलकर बोलने की हिम्मत
definition: the nerve to speak up against wrongdoing in public, when silence would be safer and far easier
example: One passenger showed some Zivilcourage and the whole carriage stopped pretending not to see.

hindi: सरकती ठंडी हवा — दरवाज़े-खिड़की की झिरी से आती धार
definition: a thin current of cold air slipping through a room, blamed in German households for many ills
example: His aunt shut the window at once, muttering about Zugluft and stiff necks.

hindi: चाल की मजबूरी — हर चाल नुक़सानदेह, फिर भी चलना अनिवार्य
definition: a position in which every available move damages you, and yet declining to move is not permitted
example: With both bids expiring Friday, the board found itself in Zugzwang.

hindi: भरोसेमंदी — कहा सो किया, समय पर
definition: dependability as a character trait: what you promise happens, on the day you said it would happen
example: He is not the fastest builder in town, but his Zuverlässigkeit fills the order book.

hindi: दो का एकांत — दो लोगों का निजी साथ
definition: the contented privacy of two people whose shared company politely excludes the rest of the world
example: They guarded their Sunday Zweisamkeit against every invitation.
